name: Saregama India
why: Latest concall: management tone confident / positive
Management outlook: On a short-to-medium-term basis, we maintain our guidance of 20% to 23% CAGR for the music vertical revenue.
Latest quarter Sep 2026: Excellent (sales +37% YoY, profit +45% YoY)
Domestic institutions (mutual funds, insurers) raised holding by 4.2 pts in a year
Promoters raised their stake by 1.2 pts in a year
Cost quality excellent: costs falling, margin expanding, operating profit growing (costs 70% to 68% of sales)
Profits backed by cash: operating cash flow is 86% of 3-year profit
risks: Not at record: quarterly sales, quarterly profit, annual sales
Working capital stretching - debtor days 45 to 66, inventory days 161 to 280 (rising): check receivables / stock build-up
FIIs (foreign funds) cut holding by 4.9 pts in a year
Sector cycle: Weak / out of favour

guidance: On a short-to-medium-term basis, we maintain our guidance of 20% to 23% CAGR for the music vertical revenue.
We continue with the guidance of a 5-year payback period for all new music bought, followed by 55 to 75 years of returns coming from that music.
focus: We are entering that cycle now, where content that was bought 2, 3 or 4 years ago is starting to contribute positive margins.
The first half of this year had greater focus on non-film music, like the I -Pop Star albums in Hindi and Tamil, which threwmultiple songs that trended on YouTube and Instagram.
Financial year 27 started with us expanding our live vertical into multiple formats, helping us diversify our risk.

about: Saregama is the oldest music label company from India (established 1902, erstwhile "Gramophone Company of India" & then "HMV"). The company is aiming to be a pure-play content company supported by the global consumption boom. [1] Since 2017, Saregama has been making headlines again owing to the launch of two unique initiatives, Saregama Carvaan and Yoodlee Films. [2]
